name: Winter's Chill
oracle_text:
Cast this spell only during combat before blockers are declared.
X can't be greater than the number of snow lands you control.
Choose X target attacking creatures. For each of those creatures, its controller may pay {1} or {2}. If that player doesn't, destroy that creature at end of combat. If that player pays only {1}, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this combat.
blocked_sentences: Cast this spell only during combat before blockers are declared.
X can't be greater than the number of snow lands you control.

Choose X target attacking creatures. For each of those creatures, its controller may pay {1} or {2}. If that player doesn't, destroy that creature at end of combat. If that player pays only {1}, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this combat.

needs.what: a card-level cap on the chosen value of X, read at cast time from a value (here {"count": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "types": ["Land"], "supertypes": ["Snow"]}}), so the cast offers no X above it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No card_level_cost_key or rider key bounds X; x_value is an activated-ability cost key and cost_reduction only discounts, so X is unbounded and the spell would be strictly better than printed

needs.what: a card-level casting restriction limiting the spell to the combat phase before the declare-blockers step (beginning of combat or declare attackers)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_during exists only as a condition_key read inside effects, not as a legality check on casting; cast_only_at_sorcery_speed is the opposite restriction and no rider key narrows an instant's casting window

needs.what: per target, the target's controller chooses among paying {2}, paying {1}, or paying nothing, with three distinct outcomes: nothing -> a delayed destroy at end of combat; {1} -> prevent all combat damage dealt to and by that creature this combat; {2} -> nothing
needs.why_existing_wont_do: may takes a single pay and player, so a nested may-pay-{2} else may-pay-{1} is an approximation of a single tiered choice; additionally the delay op's steps and prevent_damage_permanent's durations are not documented to include end of combat / this combat, and X variable-count targeting of attacking creatures with a per-target controller payment is not shown anywhere in the reference
